caption: A clear drinking glass filled with transparent liquid rests on a wooden tabletop against a plain light wall, its water level steady throughout the excerpt. Just beneath the surface, in the upper-central region of the glass, a faint white cloud-like mass hangs suspended, already present when the clip opens. Small bubbles cling to the inner wall near the surface and remain fixed as the scene holds. The white formation is soft and low in contrast at first, a pale patch with blurred edges. As the clip progresses, this mass steadily grows larger and brighter, developing distinct radial wispy tendrils that fan outward and downward through the upper portion of the liquid. Its vertical span increases, reaching further into the water column while the lower liquid stays clear. The expansion is gradual and continuous, with no new object entering and nothing leaving the frame. The glass itself does not move, so the visible change is the progressive diffusion of the suspended white cloud, which is still spreading when the excerpt ends.
relations: As the suspended white cloud diffuses, its radial wisps grow brighter and extend downward through the upper clear liquid.
The lower liquid remains clear while the cloud expands within the upper water column.
Small bubbles clinging to the inner wall near the surface stay fixed as the glass rests steadily.
The visible change is continuous diffusion of the suspended white cloud, with no object entering or leaving.
